description: Elections Commission - Declare that H. A. S. D. Thisera was selected as the member of the Ja-Ela Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette content specifically addresses the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Jaela Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves the electoral process for local authorities, including the nomination and declaration of a new member to fill a vacancy caused by a party member ceasing membership. This falls under Election Gazettes (Type 7) as it deals with electoral processes and declarations at the local government level.
